## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō Módá guówáng jīng* (T519) is a one-fascicle short sūtra by [沮渠京聲](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B2%AE%E6%B8%A0%E4%BA%AC%E8%81%B2) Jǔqú Jīngshēng. *Módá* 摩達 is likely a transcription of *Madra* (a region in northwest India).

**Abstract**

A short *avadāna*-style narrative. Translation dated to Jǔqú Jīngshēng's productive period (455–464 CE). The "kings" sub-cycle ([KR6i0136](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0136)–[KR6i0154](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0154)) preserved a remarkable concentration of these short royal narratives in Chinese transmission.
